intro_fa: یک زاغ بسیار تشنه است، اما آب در تهِ کوزه است. او چه می‌کند؟ این قصه بسیار کهنه است.
say_en: The Thirsty Crow
show_en: The Thirsty Crow

say_en: It is summer. The sun is hot and the fields are yellow. A black crow sits in a tree. She is very thirsty. "Water, water," she says. "I need water." But the river is dry. There is no water in the river, only stones.
show_en: It is summer. The sun is hot and the fields are yellow. A black crow sits in a tree. She is very thirsty. "Water, water," she says. "I need water." But the river is dry. There is no water in the river, only stones.

say_en: The crow flies over the village. She looks down. She sees houses and walls and a donkey. Then she sees a jug in a yard. "A jug!" says the crow. "People put water in jugs." She flies down and sits on the jug.
show_en: The crow flies over the village. She looks down. She sees houses and walls and a donkey. Then she sees a jug in a yard. "A jug!" says the crow. "People put water in jugs." She flies down and sits on the jug.

say_en: The crow looks into the jug. Yes! There is water. But it is only a little water, and it is far down. The crow puts her head in the jug. Her beak can't touch the water. The jug is tall and her beak is short.
show_en: The crow looks into the jug. Yes! There is water. But it is only a little water, and it is far down. The crow puts her head in the jug. Her beak can't touch the water. The jug is tall and her beak is short.

say_en: Why can't the crow drink the water?
say_fa: چرا زاغ نمی‌تواند آب را بنوشد؟
show_en: Why can't the crow drink the water?
wrong_say_fa: نه. آب کم است و در تهِ کوزه است. نول زاغ به آن نمی‌رسد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: "I can push the jug," says the crow. She pushes and pushes. But the jug is heavy and the crow is small. Then she stops. "No," she says. "If the jug falls, the water runs away into the sand. I must think."
show_en: "I can push the jug," says the crow. She pushes and pushes. But the jug is heavy and the crow is small. Then she stops. "No," she says. "If the jug falls, the water runs away into the sand. I must think."

say_en: The crow sits and thinks. She looks at the yard. She sees small stones. Many small stones. Then she has an idea! She takes one stone in her beak. She drops it into the jug. Plop! The water comes up a little.
show_en: The crow sits and thinks. She looks at the yard. She sees small stones. Many small stones. Then she has an idea! She takes one stone in her beak. She drops it into the jug. Plop! The water comes up a little.

say_en: The crow takes a stone in her beak.
show_en: The crow takes a stone in her beak.

say_en: What does the crow drop into the jug?
show_en: What does the crow drop into the jug?
wrong_say_fa: نه. زاغ سنگ‌های خُرد را در کوزه می‌اندازد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The crow takes two stones, three stones, four stones. Plop, plop, plop! It is slow work, and the sun is hot. But every stone helps. Ten stones. Twenty stones. The water comes up, and up, and up.
show_en: The crow takes two stones, three stones, four stones. Plop, plop, plop! It is slow work, and the sun is hot. But every stone helps. Ten stones. Twenty stones. The water comes up, and up, and up.

say_en: Now the water is at the top of the jug. The crow puts her beak in and drinks. The water is cool and good. She drinks and drinks. Then she flies back to her tree. "Think first," she says, "and then work, stone by stone."
show_en: Now the water is at the top of the jug. The crow puts her beak in and drinks. The water is cool and good. She drinks and drinks. Then she flies back to her tree. "Think first," she says, "and then work, stone by stone."

say_en: How does the crow get the water?
show_en: How does the crow get the water?
wrong_say_fa: نه. زاغ سنگ‌ها را در کوزه می‌اندازد و آب بالا می‌آید. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

intro_fa: آیا یک موش خُرد می‌تواند به یک شیر کلان کمک کند؟ این قصه بسیار کهنه است.
say_en: The Lion and the Mouse
show_en: The Lion and the Mouse

say_en: A big lion sleeps under a tree. He is the king of the animals. A small mouse runs in the grass. She does not look. She runs over the lion's foot, over his leg and over his nose! The lion opens one eye.
show_en: A big lion sleeps under a tree. He is the king of the animals. A small mouse runs in the grass. She does not look. She runs over the lion's foot, over his leg and over his nose! The lion opens one eye.

say_en: The lion puts his big foot on the mouse. "Who are you?" he says. "I am sleeping, and you run on my nose!" "I am sorry, king," says the mouse. "Please let me go. One day I can help you."
show_en: The lion puts his big foot on the mouse. "Who are you?" he says. "I am sleeping, and you run on my nose!" "I am sorry, king," says the mouse. "Please let me go. One day I can help you."

say_en: Who runs over the lion's nose?
say_fa: کی از روی بینی شیر می‌دود؟
show_en: Who runs over the lion's nose?
wrong_say_fa: نه. یک موش خُرد از روی بینی شیر می‌دود. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The lion laughs and laughs. "You? Help me? You are very small, and I am the king!" But he is not hungry, and the mouse is funny. "Go, little mouse," he says. He lifts his foot. "Thank you!" says the mouse, and she runs home.
show_en: The lion laughs and laughs. "You? Help me? You are very small, and I am the king!" But he is not hungry, and the mouse is funny. "Go, little mouse," he says. He lifts his foot. "Thank you!" says the mouse, and she runs home.

say_en: One week goes by. The lion walks in the forest at night. He does not see the net. It is a hunter's net, big and strong. The lion falls into it. He pulls and he pushes. He can't get out. "Help!" he calls. "Help me!"
show_en: One week goes by. The lion walks in the forest at night. He does not see the net. It is a hunter's net, big and strong. The lion falls into it. He pulls and he pushes. He can't get out. "Help!" he calls. "Help me!"

say_en: The animals hear the king. The goat comes and looks. "I can't help," says the goat. "The net is too strong." The donkey comes and looks. "I can't help," says the donkey. They go away. The lion is alone, and he is sad.
show_en: The animals hear the king. The goat comes and looks. "I can't help," says the goat. "The net is too strong." The donkey comes and looks. "I can't help," says the donkey. They go away. The lion is alone, and he is sad.

say_en: Why does the lion call "Help"?
show_en: Why does the lion call "Help"?
choices: t:he is hungry|t:he is ill|t:in a net
wrong_say_fa: نه. شیر در جال شکارچی بند مانده است و نمی‌تواند براید. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: Then the mouse comes. "I can help you, king," she says. She has small, sharp teeth. She bites the rope. She bites and bites, all night. One rope breaks. Then two. Then ten. In the morning there is a big hole in the net.
show_en: Then the mouse comes. "I can help you, king," she says. She has small, sharp teeth. She bites the rope. She bites and bites, all night. One rope breaks. Then two. Then ten. In the morning there is a big hole in the net.

say_en: The mouse has small, sharp teeth.
show_en: The mouse has small, sharp teeth.

say_en: How does the mouse open the net?
say_fa: موش جال را با چه باز می‌کند؟
show_en: How does the mouse open the net?
wrong_say_fa: نه. موش با دندان‌های تیز خود ریسمان را می‌بُرد. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The lion walks out of the net. He looks down at the mouse. "You are small," he says, "but you are a big friend. I am sorry, little mouse. I don't laugh at small friends now." From that day the lion and the mouse are good friends.
show_en: The lion walks out of the net. He looks down at the mouse. "You are small," he says, "but you are a big friend. I am sorry, little mouse. I don't laugh at small friends now." From that day the lion and the mouse are good friends.

intro_fa: خرگوش تیز می‌دود و سنگ‌پشت آهسته می‌رود. در مسابقه کدام یک اول می‌شود؟ این قصه بسیار کهنه است.
say_en: The Tortoise and the Hare
show_en: The Tortoise and the Hare

say_en: The hare can run very fast. He runs in the field every morning, and he is happy with his long legs. "Look at me!" he says to the animals. "I am fast! Who can run with me?" The animals say nothing.
show_en: The hare can run very fast. He runs in the field every morning, and he is happy with his long legs. "Look at me!" he says to the animals. "I am fast! Who can run with me?" The animals say nothing.

say_en: The tortoise walks by. She has four short legs and a house on her back. She walks slowly. Step, step, step. The hare laughs. "Look at the tortoise! She is very slow. She leaves home on Saturday and gets to school on Friday!"
show_en: The tortoise walks by. She has four short legs and a house on her back. She walks slowly. Step, step, step. The hare laughs. "Look at the tortoise! She is very slow. She leaves home on Saturday and gets to school on Friday!"

say_en: How does the tortoise walk?
show_en: How does the tortoise walk?
wrong_say_fa: نه. سنگ‌پشت آهسته آهسته راه می‌رود. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The tortoise stops. "I am slow," she says, "but I can get to the big tree on the hill before you." "You? Before me?" says the hare. "Yes. Let's have a race." All the animals come to look. The fox says: "One, two, three, go!"
show_en: The tortoise stops. "I am slow," she says, "but I can get to the big tree on the hill before you." "You? Before me?" says the hare. "Yes. Let's have a race." All the animals come to look. The fox says: "One, two, three, go!"

say_en: The hare runs. He is very fast! In one minute he is far away. He looks back. He can't see the tortoise. "She is so slow," he says. "I have time. It is hot, and here is a good tree. I can sleep a little."
show_en: The hare runs. He is very fast! In one minute he is far away. He looks back. He can't see the tortoise. "She is so slow," he says. "I have time. It is hot, and here is a good tree. I can sleep a little."

say_en: The hare sits down under the tree. He closes his eyes and sleeps. And the tortoise? She walks. Step, step, step. She is hot and tired, but she does not stop. She sees the hare under the tree. She says nothing, and she walks on.
show_en: The hare sits down under the tree. He closes his eyes and sleeps. And the tortoise? She walks. Step, step, step. She is hot and tired, but she does not stop. She sees the hare under the tree. She says nothing, and she walks on.

say_en: The hare sleeps. The tortoise walks on.
show_en: The hare sleeps. The tortoise walks on.

say_en: Why does the hare sleep?
show_en: Why does the hare sleep?
choices: t:he has time|t:he is ill|t:it is night
wrong_say_fa: نه. خرگوش فکر می‌کند که بسیار وقت دارد، چون سنگ‌پشت آهسته می‌رود. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The sun goes down. The hare opens his eyes. "Oh! The race!" He jumps up and runs. He runs fast, very fast, up the hill. But who is that under the big tree? It is the tortoise! She is there before him.
show_en: The sun goes down. The hare opens his eyes. "Oh! The race!" He jumps up and runs. He runs fast, very fast, up the hill. But who is that under the big tree? It is the tortoise! She is there before him.

say_en: The animals clap. "The tortoise is first!" The hare sits down. He is very tired and he is not happy. "How?" he says. "I am fast and you are slow." "Yes," says the tortoise. "But I don't stop."
show_en: The animals clap. "The tortoise is first!" The hare sits down. He is very tired and he is not happy. "How?" he says. "I am fast and you are slow." "Yes," says the tortoise. "But I don't stop."

say_en: Who is first at the big tree?
say_fa: کی اول به درخت کلان می‌رسد؟
show_en: Who is first at the big tree?
wrong_say_fa: نه. سنگ‌پشت اول می‌رسد، چون او ایستاد نمی‌شود. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

round: # 04: The Doves and the Net (Kalila wa Dimna)

intro_fa: کبوترها در جال بند می‌مانند. یک کبوتر تنها نمی‌تواند جال را بلند کند. همه با هم چه؟ این قصه از کتاب کهنه کلیله و دمنه است.
say_en: The Doves and the Net
show_en: The Doves and the Net

say_en: Ten white doves fly over the fields. They are hungry. Then a young dove looks down. "Look! Rice! There is rice under that tree!" The old dove says: "Stop. Why is there rice in the forest? I don't like it." But the doves are very hungry.
show_en: Ten white doves fly over the fields. They are hungry. Then a young dove looks down. "Look! Rice! There is rice under that tree!" The old dove says: "Stop. Why is there rice in the forest? I don't like it." But the doves are very hungry.

say_en: The doves fly down. They eat the rice. It is good! Then, oh no! A net falls on them. It is a hunter's net. Every dove pulls and pulls. One pulls to the mountain, one pulls to the river. The net does not move.
show_en: The doves fly down. They eat the rice. It is good! Then, oh no! A net falls on them. It is a hunter's net. Every dove pulls and pulls. One pulls to the mountain, one pulls to the river. The net does not move.

say_en: What do the doves see under the tree?
show_en: What do the doves see under the tree?
wrong_say_fa: نه. کبوترها زیر درخت برنج می‌بینند. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: "Stop!" says the old dove. "Listen to me. One dove can't lift this net. But we are ten. We must all fly up at the same time, and we must all fly the same way. Are you ready? One, two, three, fly!"
show_en: "Stop!" says the old dove. "Listen to me. One dove can't lift this net. But we are ten. We must all fly up at the same time, and we must all fly the same way. Are you ready? One, two, three, fly!"

say_en: Ten doves open their wings. Ten doves fly up. And the net goes up with them! The hunter runs out from behind a tree. "My net! My doves!" he calls. He runs after them. But the doves fly over the river, and the hunter stops.
show_en: Ten doves open their wings. Ten doves fly up. And the net goes up with them! The hunter runs out from behind a tree. "My net! My doves!" he calls. He runs after them. But the doves fly over the river, and the hunter stops.

say_en: The doves fly up, and the net goes up with them.
show_en: The doves fly up, and the net goes up with them.

say_en: Why can the doves lift the net now?
say_fa: چرا حالا کبوترها می‌توانند جال را بلند کنند؟
show_en: Why can the doves lift the net now?
choices: t:a big wind|t:all together|t:a small net
wrong_say_fa: نه. حالا همه کبوترها با هم و به یک طرف پرواز می‌کنند. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The doves are in the sky, but they are still in the net. "I have a friend," says the old dove. "He is a mouse, and he lives by the big stone on the hill. He can help us." They fly and fly. The net is heavy.
show_en: The doves are in the sky, but they are still in the net. "I have a friend," says the old dove. "He is a mouse, and he lives by the big stone on the hill. He can help us." They fly and fly. The net is heavy.

say_en: The mouse comes out of his house. "My friends! What is this?" He starts to bite the net. He bites and bites with his sharp teeth. The ropes break, one by one. "Come out, come out!" Now every dove is free.
show_en: The mouse comes out of his house. "My friends! What is this?" He starts to bite the net. He bites and bites with his sharp teeth. The ropes break, one by one. "Come out, come out!" Now every dove is free.

say_en: Who opens the net?
show_en: Who opens the net?
wrong_say_fa: نه. موش، دوست کبوترها، جال را با دندان باز می‌کند. دوباره بخوان و جواب درست را انتخاب کن.

say_en: The doves thank the mouse. Then they fly up, over the hill, into the blue sky. The young dove flies next to the old dove. "Now I know," she says. "One dove is small. But ten doves together are strong."
show_en: The doves thank the mouse. Then they fly up, over the hill, into the blue sky. The young dove flies next to the old dove. "Now I know," she says. "One dove is small. But ten doves together are strong."
